key_insight: MetaOPD learns token weights via bilevel optimization so the weighting strategy is guided by how it improves the student after an update, rather than by fixed heuristics.
engineering_relevance: This makes on-policy distillation more adaptive and potentially more effective for training smaller reasoning models that must learn from their own generated outputs.
method: Inner loop: update the student with weighted OPD on its own responses.
Outer loop: tune a lightweight token-weighting network using validation loss on reference solutions after a virtual student update.
Differentiate through the update so token weights reflect their downstream impact on learning.
evidence_signal: The paper reports results on six mathematical reasoning and three out-of-domain datasets, across two student scales and seven baselines, with MetaOPD improving Avg@8/Pass@8 over OPD by up to 2.25/6.41 points.
watch_item: Bilevel training adds optimization complexity and may be sensitive to the stability and cost of differentiating through virtual student updates.
paper_title: MetaOPD: Meta-Learned Token Weighting for On-Policy Distillation
